name: Matt Van Epps
bio: a Representative from Tennessee; born in Ohio, March 29, 1983; graduated from Mentor High School, Mentor, Ohio, 2001; graduated from United States Military Academy, West Point, N.Y., 2005; M.P.A., University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill, N.C, 2019; U.S. Army; Tennessee Army National Guard; consultant; staff, office of Governor Bill Lee of Tennessee; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress, by special election, to fill a vacancy caused by the resignation of United States Representative Mark E. Green (December 2, 2025-present).
